note: All sixteen interface-requirement rows of the analog table in section 6 of the ratified spec/usb2-phy.md (Ratified 2026-08-05), selected by hand. Row ids are `6-NN`, NN being the 1-based position of the row in that table, which has no id column (counted 2026-11-14); inserting or reordering table rows renumbers them, which the repo-side gate (signoff/check.py) catches by re-hashing the source. Namespace: this file claims the analog partition's rows only. signoff/spec/digital-rows.json claims the digital side of the two control-interface rows under slug ids (driver-control-interface for 6-08, pullup-control-interface for 6-16) and lists the rest of section 6 under excluded; the two files do not collide. This file claims only the analog side of 6-08 (the drive-enable/OE behaviour the driver testbenches exercise) and treats 6-16 as an analog-side gap: its committed evidence is the UTMI-owned digital side, not an analog-side measurement.

rows.requirement: PLL: reference input 12 MHz +/-0.25% (2500 ppm) crystal/resonator
PLL: output jitter (cycle-to-cycle, feeding oversampling clock) < 5% of one bit period (< 4.17 ns at 144 MHz, 12x oversampling of 12 Mbps)
PLL: oversampling ratio delivered to bit/edge sync logic 12x minimum
Current-mode drivers: output voltage swing, static - VOH 2.8-3.6 V (1.5 kOhm pull-up to 3.6 V), VOL 0.0-0.3 V
Current-mode drivers: driver output resistance 28-44 Ohm
Current-mode drivers: rise/fall time 4-20 ns (10%-90%), matched to within 10% rise vs. fall
Current-mode drivers: output signal crossover voltage 1.3-2.0 V
Current-mode drivers: control interface from UTMI layer - differential drive enable, output enable (OE), TxD+/TxD- data lines (analog side of the interface)
Differential receivers: differential input sensitivity |(D+) - (D-)| > 200 mV
Differential receivers: common-mode input range 0.8-2.5 V
Differential receivers: single-ended receiver thresholds VIH > 2.0 V, VIL < 0.8 V
Squelch / envelope detector: squelch detection threshold (differential envelope) 100-200 mV
Squelch / envelope detector: output interface to UTMI layer - single-bit SQUELCH/LineState status, sampled at the oversampling clock rate
Pull-up/pull-down and termination: FS device D+ pull-up 1.5 kOhm +/-5% to internally regulated 3.0-3.6 V
Pull-up/pull-down and termination: downstream port pull-downs 15 kOhm +/-5% on each of D+/D-
Pull-up/pull-down and termination: control interface from UTMI layer - single-bit pull-up enable/disable, driven during reset/attach/suspend sequencing
